steps_learned: Check the Gold-Silver ratio to decide where to invest.
If the ratio is above 80, silver is historically undervalued compared to gold.
Understand that gold is stable while silver is volatile due to higher industrial demand (55%).
Choose gold options for lower risk and silver ETFs if you can handle higher risk.
Allocate 5-10% of your portfolio to these metals.
